help_required.arguments: Arguments: require INPUT is mandatory; read has no required operands.
help_required.defaults: Defaults: no input, config file, project or service is selected.
help_required.examples: Examples: pilot item read --json; pilot item require INPUT --json.
help_required.side effects: Side effects: isolated output observation only; no service or resource mutations.
help_required.exit codes: Exit codes: 0 completed/accepted, 1 crash, 2 usage, 3 verification, 4 blocked, 5 service, 124 deadline, 130 interrupted.
help_required.configuration precedence: Configuration precedence: explicit flags only; no config or project files.
help_required.schema: Payload schema: pilot.payload version 2, independent of executable 2.0.0.
help_required.mapping: Mapping: contract=v2, path=command, success=ok, payload=data, problems=errors, correlation=request_id, state=done/completed or failed/failed; errors use identity field mappings.
help_required.simultaneous failures: Simultaneous failures: usage category 2 takes precedence; parse failures retain their error.
